editorial.name: Statamic
editorial.descriptionZh: Statamic 是跑在 Laravel 上的 CMS，控制面板可改，内容既能存 flat file 也能转数据库，配套 marketplace 卖 addon 和 starter kit。首页首屏就是一张手绘插画加一张控制面板截图。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它把插画背景和后台截图拼进同一张首屏
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是一整张暖色手绘插画（云、松林、瀑布、鹿、巨嘴鸟），正中 Build sites you're proud of, with a CMS you actually like，副标题点名 award-winning user experience 与 all the power of Laravel，按钮 Get Pro Now 与 Try the Demo，底下补一句 If you're a developer, why not install locally?。插画下沿压着一张控制面板截图，顶栏是 Statamic Pro / Collections / Articles，左栏 Dashboard 与 Content、Collections，正文标题正是 From Meme to Hero: How Florida Man Saved a Community，右上角有紫色的 Save & Publish 按钮。导航分 Developers、Pricing、Product、Marketplace、Partners、Community，正文五块讲 New in Statamic、Enjoy a control panel designed to adapt to you、From flat file to database, Statamic scales with you、Explore the ever-expanding Statamic Ecosystem、Created with Statamic。页脚把开发者入口排得很满：Documentation、YouTube、Laracasts Video Course、Release Notes、Roadmap、Starter Kits、Become a Creator、Partner Directory、Discord。
editorial.pricing: 有 /pricing 与 Try the Demo，首页同时给 install locally 入口

reasons.statement: 用户从 Statamic 拿走的是可安装、可自己搭的内容后台：首页并列 Get Pro Now 与 install locally，文档、Release Notes、Roadmap、Starter Kits 都指向搭建与部署这一环节，故归构建、部署与开发工作流。
库里同类 CMS 产品（Sanity、DatoCMS、Directus）都归 build-deploy-dev-workflow，Statamic 的位置一致。
